text: LPR连续16个月不变，业内称短期降息必要性不高 国内经济基本面、银行经营压力、海外货币政策收紧等多重因素共同作用下的审慎选择。
text_en: LPR unchanged for 16 consecutive months; industry says the need for near-term rate cuts is not high—a prudent choice under the combined effect of multiple factors including domestic economic fundamentals, pressure on bank operations, and tightening overseas monetary policy.
